name: TIDAL
summary:
TIDAL is the music service at tidal.com. The black-and-white wordmark in the tab is the icon this page records, taken from the host response rather than from a press kit.

Checked 12 November 2026 against tidal.com. HTML came from https://www.tidal.com/ (HTTP 403). No icon link tags were readable in the HTML. Files below came from a manifest or from a path that returned an image.

The favicon.ico URL is https://tidal.com/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 7406 bytes. Directory sizes: 16×16, 32×32, 48×48.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

No brand colour could be derived. The page had no theme-color, mask-icon colour, or manifest theme_color, and a dominant pixel colour was not readable from the saved PNGs.

The only measured sizes are inside favicon.ico: 16×16, 32×32, 48×48.
